name: Runner's Lunge Stretch
steps: Step one foot forward into a long lunge and place your hands on the floor beside the front foot.
Extend your back leg straight behind you with your rear knee hovering off the floor or resting gently down for support.
Lift your chest and ease your hips forward until you feel a gentle stretch at the front of the rear hip.
Hold the stretch steadily with slow breaths on one side, then step back and switch legs.
tips: Keep your front knee stacked directly over your ankle rather than pushing far past your toes.
Relax your shoulders away from your ears and breathe calmly into tight hip muscles.
